title: Jumptown Skydiving

services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: At Jumptown, safety is our top priority, and one way we ensure that is to invest in the best equipment, aircraft, and staff available. As such, our skydiving prices are neither the most expensive nor the least expensive in the Boston / New England area. But because of that commitment, you can be sure that you will have a top-tier skydiving experience. From the moment you walk through the door until your feet are safely back on terra firma, you’ll know you made the right choice skydiving with Jumptown. Check out our standard pricing below, and follow us on social media for specials. Read more about the tandem skydiving experience at Jumptown here. Tandem skydiving at Jumptown starts at $267

explain.meaning: You jump strapped to an instructor who handles the parachute.
